title: Coburn's implant scans of experiencers
summary: Steve Coburn tells of Coburn's implant scans of experiencers, about recent at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And um I've done probably 400 scans on on people and uh

plain: Steve Coburn, a scientist who studies what he believes are alien implants in human bodies, says he has done about 400 scans on people who report contact with non-human beings. He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast and mentions Roger Leir, another researcher of such implants. If true, it would mean physical objects of unknown origin are being found inside people.
